title: The CFO is live on video
scenario: You join a video call where people who look and sound like senior executives discuss a confidential acquisition. They direct you to execute an unusual payment immediately and say written approval will follow.

answers.A: Ask for the normal written approval and a second independent approver before taking action.
answers.B: Proceed because multiple executives are visibly present and the discussion includes confidential company details.
answers.C: Do not rely on the call alone; follow established payment approvals and independently verify with known executives or signatories.

explanation: Deepfake or synthetic video can reproduce faces and voices, while breached data can supply internal context. Process must authenticate the transaction.
proTip: Video presence is evidence of pixels, not payment authority.
